features.quote: Enjoy the full package (5-star All-Inclusive hotel + dance + parties) for just €1,290.
features.rationale: The full package includes the 5-star All-Inclusive hotel stay together with the dance and parties.

features.quote: 24-hour All-Inclusive package: Gourmet buffets and unlimited drinks.
features.rationale: The All-Inclusive package explicitly includes gourmet buffets and unlimited drinks.
Transfers are included in the package, so transport is provided.
The event includes 10 hours of dance workshops.
The workshops are described as intensive, forming an intensive training course.
